correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed the full RESULT.md proof for [X,Y]=Y^2 on all M_n(F_q), q=p^f, and reduced support dimensions over algebraic closure. The nondegenerate trace pairing gives im(ad_Y)=Cent(Y)^perp, even in characteristic p. For a Jordan block B=lambda I_s+N_s, the diagonal centralizer polynomial gives tr(B^2 C)=s lambda^2 c_0; individual block projections prove necessity, and vanishing for all centralizer matrices proves sufficiency. Rank of the linear system is stable under scalar extension, so solvability descends. Rational canonical primary decomposition and centralizer-unit cardinalities cancel affine-fiber q exponents, and the q-binomial identity plus product over nonzero-constant monic polynomials yield exactly q^(1_{p|j}) for Euler factors indexed by j. Orbit dimension plus affine fiber gives n^2 for n<p, and the lambda-parameter family of a single length-p nonzero-eigenvalue block gives p^2+1 at n=p; exact nonnilpotent contribution q|GL_p(q)|. Independently reconstructed the seven-entry source-tree SHA-1 from actual blob names and hashes: 0a0ab511259c55d9d60bfd59c7b13bd47f1338e2. Independent rational-coefficient product/partition comparisons checked n<=7 for q=2,3,4. Independent exhaustive finite-field commutator linear-solvability counts checked (q,n)=(2,1),(2,2),(2,3),(3,1),(3,2),(3,3),(4,2), including nonprime F4; totals 2,40,2192,3,153,95499,1216 and relevant nonnilpotent contributions 12,672,33696,720. Finite checks corroborate rather than prove the arbitrary-n statements.
residual_risks: Finite enumeration cannot independently certify the all-n theorem; the trace-pairing/primary-Euler calculation is necessary.
The algebraic geometry conclusion concerns reduced support dimensions only, not scheme reducedness or multiplicities.

value.rationale: The Jordan plane is a natural noncommutative algebra with established characteristic-zero representation theory and modular irreducible modules. A complete all-Jordan-type solvability classification and every-size, every-finite-field labeled representation count answer canonical, nontrivial representation enumeration questions; the periodic selection of precisely p-divisible block sizes cannot be recovered from the previously known nilpotent-only Feit–Fine product by mere parameter substitution. The sharp first nonnilpotent geometric dimension jump at n=p supplies a structurally motivated boundary. This does not claim a new universal centralizer count technique, new simple-module existence, or full scheme/irreducible-component classifications.
residual_risks: Broader modular representation-scheme geometry, component classification and integrality of all orbit-scheme structures are not claimed.
Known characteristic-zero/nilpotent-only results are already significant special cases and should be credited.
